title: Utility Sector Relative Strength Reversal After Volatility Crush
thesis: When XLU volatility compresses sharply below its 90-day median while underperforming broad market, defensive rotation often triggers mean-reversion buying in utilities as risk appetite stabilizes. reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: Volatility cycles in utilities are frequent and driven by interest rate expectations; signal fires 2-3 times per quarter.
